Found why. By tonight's two rules, any line you type in Team starts design mode ('when i sent anything to team chat, we're all in design mode'), and starting a design clears the board ('if i start a new one the board clears'). So after each End design mode, your next Team line brings the button back AND empties the board. That's why you saw nothing to attend to. I've reposted the board. Proposed fix: design mode starts only when a goal is NAMED, not on any Team line. Then you can talk in Team freely, and End design mode stays ended until you name the next goal, which is also what clears the old board. Go?
